lecture-hall.definition: A large room at a school or college built for teaching many students at once.

laboratory.definition: A room equipped for scientific experiments, observations, or practical study.

dormitory.definition: A building or residence providing accommodation for students.

student-center.definition: A campus facility providing spaces and services for student activities.

gymnasium.definition: Athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training.

cafeteria.definition: A restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier.

administration.definition: The staff responsible for managing the university’s operations and records.

auditorium.definition: A large room or hall for an audience attending talks or performances.

chapel.definition: A small Christian place of worship.

quad.definition: An open campus courtyard, often surrounded by buildings.

courtyard.definition: An area wholly or partly surrounded by walls or buildings.

fountain.definition: A structure that sends water upward and lets it fall back down.

statue.definition: A three-dimensional figure representing a person, animal, or other subject, made by carving, casting, or another process.
statue.exampleUsage: A statue stood beside the university library.

clock-tower.definition: A tower designed with a large clock displayed high on an exterior wall.

gate.definition: A movable barrier at a campus entrance.

pathway.definition: A route for walking between places on a university campus.

parking-lot.definition: An area with marked spaces where vehicles can be parked.
parking-lot.exampleUsage: The campus parking lot is beside the sports center.

sports-field.definition: An outdoor area, usually covered with grass or artificial turf, where athletes practice and compete within marked boundaries.

computer-lab.definition: A room equipped with computers for study, teaching, or research.

art-studio.definition: A room or workspace equipped for creating visual art.
art-studio.exampleUsage: Students worked on paintings in the art studio.

music-room.definition: A room equipped or reserved for music lessons, practice, or rehearsal.
music-room.exampleUsage: The music room has several practice instruments.

theater.definition: A building or space for presenting plays and other performances.

swimming-pool.definition: A large basin filled with water where people swim, practice, relax, or compete.

track.definition: A marked running course used for athletics.

tennis-court.definition: A marked playing area where people compete in tennis by hitting a ball over a net.

health-center.definition: A campus clinic or service that provides basic healthcare and health support for students.
health-center.exampleUsage: The student health center provides appointments with qualified healthcare staff.

counseling-center.definition: A campus service where students can receive personal or mental-health support.

career-center.definition: A campus office that helps students with career planning, job-search skills, and employment opportunities.
career-center.exampleUsage: The career center reviewed her résumé.

orientation.definition: A program that introduces new students to university life.

registration.definition: The process of officially signing up as a student or for courses.

move-in-day.definition: The day when students move their belongings into campus housing or a new residence.
move-in-day.exampleUsage: Families helped students carry boxes on move-in day.

homecoming.definition: A school or university event welcoming former students back, often with social activities and sports.

spring-break.definition: A scheduled pause in classes during the spring academic term at some institutions.

finals-week.definition: The period near the end of an academic term when many final examinations take place.
finals-week.exampleUsage: The library stays busy during finals week.

study-abroad.definition: An educational program in which a student studies in another country for a period of time.
study-abroad.exampleUsage: She attended an information session about study-abroad programs.

internship-fair.definition: An event where students meet organizations offering internships and learn about available placements.
internship-fair.exampleUsage: Students spoke with employers at the internship fair.

alumni-weekend.definition: A weekend of events organized for former students to return to a school or university.
alumni-weekend.exampleUsage: The university hosts alumni weekend each autumn.

library.definition: A room or building containing books and other resources for reading, study, or reference.

garden.definition: An outdoor area where plants are grown or displayed.
